name: Braille Charm
description: A small charm, pendant, or zipper pull carrying one or two braille cells. Type a character or two and the translation to Unicode braille runs entirely on your device via liblouis. Prints flat, or angled with a break-away support fin for the crispest dots.
author: OpenSCAD Assistive Forge contributors

inspired_by.name: Nasif Zaman (charm base) and Brennen Johnston (braille dot system)
